name: site-viewer-lite
description: Site Viewer Lite — Full Stack 3D Platform (BIM + LiDAR)

scripts.quickstart: npm run setup && npm run setup:clouds && npm run dev
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix Backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix Backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix Backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
